subject: Post-remediation confirmation and brief delta attestation request
body:
Message 1 - 2027-06-02T09:12:00Z
From: Elaine Park <epark@acme-enterprises.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Subject: Follow-up: confirmation after remediation for Acme scope

Hi Jonas and team,

Thanks for the remediation summary you sent last week. Acme Security needs a short, formal confirmation that the issues from the June 2027 penetration test have been addressed and that you are able to support a limited verification run (re-test) against the compensated items. Our auditors expect: a) a delta summary of fixes, b) the retest window, and c) a short attestation that the fixes were implemented by your engineering team.

Can you provide that attestation and a proposed 2‑hour window for the verification run next week? Also let us know if you have any non-production endpoints we should use for the validation.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, Information Security
Acme Enterprises

---
Message 2 - 2027-06-03T11:04:00Z
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <epark@acme-enterprises.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Follow-up: confirmation after remediation for Acme scope

Elaine,

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answer: yes — we can provide a concise attestation and schedule a focused verification window.

What I will do today:
- Loop in Security for the delta summary and preserved evidence. (Marissa will attach the brief.)
- Confirm the internal sign-off and propose two candidate slots for the 2‑hour verification run.
- Confirm an isolated, non-prod validation endpoint and test credentials.

Expected deliverables by EOD: a one‑page delta summary PDF, a short attestation statement (signed by our security lead), and two slot options for next week.

Jonas Weber
Manager, Solutions — Redwood Inference

---
Message 3 - 2027-06-04T15:38:00Z
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <epark@acme-enterprises.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Subject: Delta summary and evidence snapshot for Acme pen test fixes
Attachments: redwood-delta-summary-20270602.pdf (application/pdf), evidence-snapshot-logs-20270603.tar.gz (application/gzip)

Elaine — attaching the requested artifacts. Notes:
- redwood-delta-summary-20270602.pdf: one page that maps each finding (ID) to remediation steps, code/infra change links, and verifier notes.
- evidence-snapshot-logs-20270603.tar.gz: contains filtered logs and a trimmed config snapshot demonstrating the mitigations. We intentionally excluded sensitive user data; logs are sanitized.

Two candidate windows for a 2‑hour validation run (US/Pacific):
- Tuesday 2027-06-08 14:00–16:00 PT
- Wednesday 2027-06-09 09:00–11:00 PT

Non-prod validation endpoint: https://validate-us-west-1.redwood-inference.internal (credentials to be provided via the vendor portal on the day of the test).

Short attestation (draft):
"Redwood Inference attests that the vulnerabilities documented in the penetration test report dated 2027-05-28 have been remediated. The attached delta summary details the changes implemented. Redwood performed internal verification, and we authorize a focused external verification run against the supplied non-production endpoint."

Requesting Elaine confirm preferred slot and whether BlueCrowd will perform an external handshake or we should provide a temporary service account.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Information Security Lead
Redwood Inference

---
Message 4 - 2027-06-09T17:45:00Z
From: BlueCrowd Security <security@bluecrowd.com>
To: Elaine Park <epark@acme-enterprises.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Subject: Re: Post-remediation verification run confirmation

On Wed, Jun 9, 2027 at 09:03 Elaine Park <epark@acme-enterprises.com> wrote:
> Hi team — we prefer the Wednesday slot (2027-06-09 09:00–11:00 PT). BlueCrowd will run a time-boxed verification focused on the remediated findings.

Thanks for the artifacts, Marissa. BlueCrowd confirms we will use the supplied non-prod endpoint and request the temporary service account. We will only execute the agreed scope. After the run, we will provide:
1) a short verification letter stating which findings were validated as remediated,
2) any residual observations (low/informational), and
3) short reproduction notes tied to the delta report IDs.

Expected delivery of the verification letter: within 48 hours of the run. If everything looks good, Acme can use that letter to close the audit item.

Regards,
Samir Khan
Principal Consultant
BlueCrowd Security
security@bluecrowd.com
